content: Yesu ꞌina yatala Pailato matana
Coinega mabwaiyadi sitoholowa, ta Yesu sitoeya ta sitauyeya toloina madouna sanina Pailato ꞌoina, sabi yatalae.

Sitauyeya Pailatoina ꞌoina, ta Yesu weyahina sihepwaila ꞌaboꞌabowa, sigwaeya, “Loheya bewa ꞌina heꞌita ꞌahesagohediya ta ꞌabehega tauma meYudiya ꞌihawasiyemai, beno gide ꞌigwaeya, ‘Sahena Kini Sisa ꞌana takesi walagulagu, weyahina taugu kiniina, ta Toꞌabihetenaigu.’”
Coinega Pailato Yesu ꞌihesilaleya, ꞌigwaeya, “Togidega, ꞌowa meYudiya ꞌidi kini, wa?” Ta ꞌihegwaeya, ꞌigwae, “Beno ꞌugwae pwaiya.”
Ta muliyetega Pailato topwaoliyedi ta bodao ꞌihegwaediya ꞌigwaeya, “Loheya bewa geya ꞌeta ꞌina pui yaloba.”

Ma taudi tuwa siheꞌewa yahiya, sigwae, “Ciꞌaboꞌabowego beno, weyahina ꞌaloba pwaiya tomota ꞌiꞌaboꞌabowedi ma ꞌabehega gabemaniyao ꞌoidiyega ꞌiwatahidi. Weyahina Galili ꞌoina ꞌihegaineya ꞌina ꞌaboina, ta Yudiya tupwanao mabwaiyadi ꞌilohegumwalidiya, ma ꞌilatu pwaima tupwa bewa ꞌoina.”
Yesu ꞌina yatala Helodi matana
Cidi gwae bewa Pailato ꞌihesagoheya ta ꞌihegwaediya, “Togidega tauna gwama Galili, wa?”

Ma taudi sigwaeya, “Cehe, gide.” Coinega Pailato ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwaeya, “Galili beno Helodi ꞌina ꞌebeloina, ꞌoinega Yesu watauye Helodi ꞌoina ma tauna ꞌiloinae, weyahina bewa tuwa Helodi ꞌebwa Yelusalema ꞌoina ꞌimiyamiya.”

Sitauyeya Helodi ꞌoina, ta tutaina Helodi Yesu ꞌiꞌiteya ꞌiyaliyaya madouna, weyahina tuta dudulena Helodiina nuwanuwana ma Yesu ꞌiꞌita, weyahina wasana ꞌihesagoheya, ta ꞌina paihowa waiwaidi nuwanuwana ma ꞌiꞌitadi.
Coinega Helodi Yesu ꞌihesilala hedadeya, ta geya ꞌaigeda wete ꞌida hemaiseya.
Ta topwaoli madoudi ta loina ꞌana toheꞌitao silaga Helodi ꞌoina, ma Yesu siheheꞌewa tubatubali.
Ma ꞌoinega Helodi maꞌina toloꞌalehao Yesu silolotuyaneya ta siꞌahwa galegaleya. Ma muliyetega kini ꞌana ꞌwama siheꞌoteya ma sihesumane hileya Pailato ꞌoina.
Sabweloina ꞌoina Helodi ma Pailato ꞌidi hegamwagamwagu tuta dudulena ꞌoinega siheꞌiyaꞌiyaguwa.
Yesu ꞌina ꞌamasa weyahina
Coinega Pailato Topwaoli Madoudi ma babada ta tupwana meYudiyaedi ꞌibwau heꞌautedima,

ta ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwaeya, “Loheya bewa ꞌoiguwa waꞌeweyama ta wahepwaileya ꞌabehega tomota ꞌiꞌwaniyediya, ta matamiya yaheyatala pwaiyeya ma geya ꞌaigeda ꞌina pui yalobaloba ꞌimi heꞌewaowedi ꞌoidiyega.
Helodi wete geya ꞌaigeda pui ꞌilobaloba, ta ꞌoida ꞌihesumane hileyama. Coinega geya wete loheꞌamasa ꞌilobwaine,
ma sapimo ꞌiloba, ma ꞌoinega yatagwala ma ꞌitauya.”
Coinega bodaedi mahemahetena sibwauwa sigwaeya, “Tauna ꞌiꞌamasa, ma hesi Balaba ꞌulihasi weyahima.”
Balabaina loheꞌamasa weyahina deliya silaguya, weyahina tupwaina ꞌoina mwalo Balaba maꞌiyanao meLoma siloꞌalehediya, ta tupwana loheloheya siloheꞌamasidiya.
Ma Pailato nuwanuwana ma Yesu ꞌiꞌetolihasi, ꞌoinega boda wete ꞌihesilalediya,
ma hesi taudi siꞌalamanimanini hedadeya, sigwaeya, “Kelose ꞌoina tatutu hepaꞌine!”

Pailato ꞌina gwae hetoina ꞌoina ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwaeya, “Toꞌaha hede ꞌina pui ta ꞌoinega ꞌabehega ꞌamasa ꞌiloba? Weyahina geya ꞌeta wete galana ꞌoina yalobaloba. Ma hesi sapimo ꞌilobwaineya ma muliyetega yalihasi.”
Ma hesi bodaedi tuwa ꞌabwa sibwaubwau hedahedade, sigwaegwae, “Kelose ꞌoina tatutu hepaꞌine!” Ta bodaedi ꞌidi gwae ꞌihewaiwaiya,
ꞌoinega Pailato ꞌoidiya ꞌitagwala ma Yesu sida ꞌabihekelose.

Ma loheyaina nuwanuwadi ꞌiꞌetolihasi weyahidi, tuwa ꞌiꞌetolihasiya, tauna toloheꞌamasaina deliya silaguya mwalo tutaina tauna meLoma ꞌidi tohanugetao ꞌiloꞌaleha ꞌoidiya. Coinega Pailatoina boda nimadiya Yesu ꞌilaguya, ma ꞌidi nuwatuhuina sida losalohi.
Yesu kelose ꞌoina situtu hepaꞌiyeya

Yesu sitoe pwaiya ta sitauyeya, ma ꞌedai ꞌaigeda loheya sanina Saimoni silobeya, tauna gwama Sailini, pwatulega ꞌilatuma ta ꞌitautauya ꞌasai. Coinega toloꞌalehaowedi Saimoniina siloineya ta Yesu ꞌana kelose ꞌiꞌahaliya, ta ꞌimuliya.
Ma boda madouna Yesu simuliyeya, ma wete wahiwahine baibaiwadi simulimuliya, ma sidoudou maꞌidi nuwagala Yesu weyahina.
Ma Yesu ꞌiꞌitahila ta wahiwahineyedi ꞌihegwaediya, “Comi Yelusalema wahiwahinediyao, sahena weyahigu wadoudou, ma ꞌomi waboi weyahimi ma natumiyao weyahidi wadou,
weyahina tuta ꞌinaonaoma ꞌoina mwau ꞌilatu ma taiyawedi ꞌomi ꞌagaꞌagalimi, nuwana geya natumimo, nata bwebweꞌana waloba.
Weyahina tutaedi ꞌoidiya ꞌabwa tomota ꞌoya ꞌoidiya sigwae, ‘Coya, wabeꞌuma ma wasamumai!’
Moisa, taugu nata yahesilae, ma ꞌomi ꞌabwa wahesilae geyogeyoi. Weyahina taugu gide ꞌaiwe ꞌidahigu, ma ꞌomi tuwa gide ꞌaiwe ꞌamaꞌamasidi.”
Ma togala wete ꞌeluwa sitoediya ta Yesu baꞌidanao siloheꞌamasidi.

Coinega ꞌaigeda tupwa ꞌoina silatuwa, sanina Mwagu, ma tupwaina ꞌoina kelose baleꞌuwa silaguya ma Yesu situtu hepaꞌineya ma sihetoholoya, ma togalaedi siteluwa wete ꞌadi kelose ꞌoidiya situtu hepaꞌiyediya, ta ꞌaigeda Yesu ꞌebeulanega, ma heluwena Yesu ꞌadigeyageyanega sihetoholodiya.

Coinega Yesu ꞌigwaeya, “Tamagu yo, ꞌidi pui bewa ꞌunuwasamudi, weyahina geya sisanapu toꞌaha sipaipaihowa.” Ma toloꞌalehaowedi Yesu ꞌana ꞌwama siꞌeweya, ta ꞌoinega siꞌeheyaheyaleya, tuwa gide siulahesinuwa, ma ꞌoinega ꞌeguma taiyawedi sinugeta ꞌwamaedi siꞌewadi.

Nage ꞌoina tomota siꞌeꞌebubuna, ta meYudiya ꞌadi tohanugetao Yesu silolotuyaneya, sigwaegwae, “Hali tomota ꞌiꞌabihetediya, ma hana bewa tuwa tauna ꞌida ꞌabihete, ꞌeguma tauna Toꞌabihetena Keliso Yehoba ꞌoinega.”
Toloꞌalehaowedi wete Yesu silotuyaneya, ta waini memaina siꞌeweyama ta siꞌabihaneheya,
ma sigwaeya, “Ceguma ꞌowa meYudiya ꞌidi kini, ꞌuꞌetopelego ꞌuboi.”
Ma wete ꞌana kelose pwatana ꞌina ꞌamasa huhuna sileleya, ꞌigwaeya, “Loheya bewa meYudiya ꞌidi kini.”
Keloseyedi ꞌoidiyega ꞌaigeda togalaina Yesu ꞌiheliyeya, ꞌigwaeya, “Toꞌaha weyahina ꞌowa Toꞌabihetenaina, ma geya ꞌuꞌetopelegita?”
Ma togalaina heluwena ꞌiyanaina ꞌiheliyeya, ꞌigwae, “Togidega Yehoba geya ꞌumataute? Ma ꞌuhesagohe tatetoi ꞌada loina ꞌaigeda tuwa siꞌebwaegita,
ma loinaina ꞌowa ma taugu ꞌilobwainegita, weyahina tauda togala, ma loheya bewa geya ꞌeta ꞌina puimo.”
Coinega loheyaina Yesu ꞌihegwaeya, “Yesu, ꞌabwa ꞌino hetoloina ꞌana tuta, sowasowahina ma ꞌunuwatuhugau?”
Ma Yesu ꞌigwaeya, “Yagwae moisa ꞌoiuwa, ꞌowa ma taugu tupwa ꞌausalana ꞌoina nata tamiyamiya.”
Yesu ꞌina ꞌamasa
Casudiladila ma sinala ꞌiguguyouwa, ꞌoinega tupwa mabwaiyana ꞌiguguyouwa ta ꞌana siga lahilahiya ꞌasa ꞌiꞌasilala hila.
Ma ꞌaleꞌoina ꞌoinega Hada Heꞌasisi sibiliupeya, tutaina ꞌoina ꞌilotaigala luwa.
Coinega Yesu ꞌenana madounega ꞌibwauwa, ꞌigwaeya, “Tamagu yo, yaluyaluwagu nimauwa yalagulagu.” Cina gwae bewa ꞌigwaeneya ma yawasina ꞌigumwala.
Nage ꞌoina toloꞌalehao ꞌadi tohanugeta ꞌiꞌiteya Yesu yawasina ꞌigumwala, ꞌoinega Yehoba ꞌihepwatuweya ꞌigwaeya, “Moisa, loheya bewa loheya bwebweꞌana.”
Ma wete toꞌebubuna mabwaiyadi tupwaina ꞌoina siꞌetoꞌautama Yesuina ꞌina ꞌamasa siꞌiteya, ta maꞌidi nuwagala sihila ꞌidi ꞌasa.
Ma Yesu ꞌiyanao ta wete wahiwahineyedi mwalo Galiliyega simuliyeyama, taudi bwaga sitotoholo ma Yesu ꞌina ꞌamasa siꞌeꞌebubu.
Yesu ꞌana lagu taona

Caigeda loheya sanina Yosepa, Yudiya loheyaina ꞌina ꞌasa ꞌiꞌiuna Alimatiya, tauna loheya bwebweꞌana ta maꞌana hemisa. Loheyaina meYudiya ꞌidi tohanugeta ꞌaigeda, ta ꞌiyamwayamwa ma to tuta Yehoba ꞌihetoloina meYudiya ꞌoidiya. Mwalo tutaina tohanugetao nuwanuwadi ma Yesu siloheꞌamasi, ma Yosepaina geya nuwana.
Loheyaina Pailato ꞌoina ꞌitauya, ta Yesu wahina ꞌiꞌahwanoiyeya ma ꞌabehega ꞌigalihe.

Coinega Pailato ꞌitagwala, ta Yosepa maꞌiyanao Yesu wahina kelose ꞌoinega siꞌewa suluheyama, ta siwaduhiya ꞌaleꞌo waꞌewaꞌeꞌena ꞌoinega, ma muliyetega sigaliheya. Gogoina siyalaiya gide tuwa duluha dimwa ꞌalona, ma geya ꞌaigeda tuta toꞌamasa wahina ꞌoina silagu.
Sabwelo nage ꞌoina meYudiya ꞌidi tuta ꞌatububuna ꞌidi Sabati weyahina.
Ma wahiwahineyedi mwalo Galiliyega Yesu simuliyeyama taudi sitauya Yesu ꞌana galiha siꞌiteya, ma wete wahina ꞌana ꞌebelagu siꞌiteya.
Coinega sihila ꞌasai ta holowa ꞌausalana siꞌatububuya Yesu wahina ꞌana holowa weyahina, ta sabweloina mulina siꞌaiyawasiya, weyahina Sabati gide ꞌana loina.
